labeling: invented team, repositories and facts; every query was labelled by the case author (an agent) against all facts when the file was written, before any run: useful answers the query, related is on its topic without answering, misleading is a stale fact or another system's value; any other returned fact counts as noise

facts.keywords: postgres, staging, pgbouncer, port, nyx, база, стейджинг
facts.text: Staging Postgres of billing-api runs on host nyx behind pgbouncer on port 6432; connect through pgbouncer, not to Postgres on 5432 directly.
Production Postgres of billing-api is the managed cluster db-prod.example.com, port 5432, reachable only through the VPN.
Staging Postgres of billing-api runs on host db-old, port 5432.

facts.keywords: git, force push, main, rebase, история
facts.text: Never force-push to main in any repository; rebase only feature branches. Reason: the release job tags commits on main, and a rewritten main broke the changelog twice.
Commit messages are always written in English, even when the discussion is in Russian.

facts.keywords: money, amount, int64, cents, float, деньги, копейки
facts.text: billing-api stores money as int64 minor units (cents), never float64; decided after rounding errors in the March invoices.

facts.keywords: go test, race, cgo, CGO_ENABLED, atlas, CI
facts.text: In billing-api CI, `go test -race ./...` fails on the runner atlas unless CGO_ENABLED=1 is set: the runner image sets CGO_ENABLED=0.
atlas is the self-hosted GitLab runner with 16 cores; jobs tagged `heavy` run there.
Grafana for all services runs on host vega at https://grafana.example.com; the billing dashboard is 'Billing / Payments overview'.
billing-api runs on host orion as the systemd unit billing-api.service; its logs go to journald (journalctl -u billing-api).
billing-api writes its logs to /var/log/billing/app.log on host orion.

facts.keywords: node, nodejs, version, sharp, build, нода
facts.text: shop-web builds only with Node 22: Node 24 breaks the native sharp image dependency at install time.

facts.keywords: pnpm, npm, yarn, package manager, пакетный менеджер
facts.text: shop-web uses pnpm, not npm or yarn: the user chose it to share the package store with the monorepo cache on atlas.

facts.keywords: deploy, release, production, cdn, выкатка, релиз
facts.text: To deploy shop-web to production: tag vX.Y.Z on main, run the manual GitLab job deploy-prod, then purge the CDN with `cdnctl purge shop`.
On 2026-10-20 shop-web checkout was down for 40 minutes because the payment provider's webhook secret expired; it was rotated the same day.
Документацию внутренних сервисов пишем по-русски, README публичных репозиториев — по-английски.

facts.keywords: backup, pgbackrest, S3, бэкап, резервная копия
facts.text: Бэкапы базы billing снимает pgBackRest каждую ночь в 02:30 UTC на хосте nyx; хранятся 14 дней в S3-бакете billing-backups.

facts.keywords: pgbackrest, archive-push, timeout, S3, quota, квота
facts.text: pgBackRest на nyx падает с 'archive-push timeout', когда в S3 кончается квота; помогает удалить старые full-бэкапы, а не перезапуск сервиса.
Доступ к продовым хостам только через WireGuard VPN wg0 на gw.example.com; конфиг выдаёт администратор, самому не генерировать.

facts.keywords: feature flag, flags, toggle, флаг, фича
facts.text: Feature flags of billing-api live in the `flags` table, not in environment variables: the user wants to flip them without a deploy.

facts.keywords: sentry, errors, exceptions, ошибки, project id
facts.text: Errors of billing-api and shop-web go to self-hosted Sentry at https://sentry.example.com; project ids: billing=4, shop=7.

facts.keywords: sentry, source maps, sourcemaps, minified, stack trace
facts.text: shop-web uploads source maps to Sentry only when SENTRY_RELEASE equals the git tag; a mismatch leaves stack traces minified.
billing-api keeps idempotency keys in Redis on host orion, port 6380 (not 6379), with a 24 h TTL.
shop-web caches product pages in Redis on host orion, port 6379, database 2.

facts.keywords: make, lint, test, push, CI, проверки
facts.text: Run `make lint test` before every push: the user does not want CI to be the first place a failure shows up.

facts.keywords: api, versioning, version, url, header, версия
facts.text: The public API of billing-api is versioned in the URL path (/v1, /v2), not by a header: easier caching at the CDN.
Change DNS of example.com only through terraform in the infra repository (infra/dns), never by hand in the Cloudflare dashboard: manual edits are overwritten on the next apply.
Transactional email of shop-web goes through Postmark, server 'shop-transactional'; the bounce webhook points at /hooks/postmark on shop-web.
Grafana alerts on vega go to the Telegram chat 'ops-alerts'; e-mail alerts are not read by anyone.
In the infra repository run every ansible playbook against nyx with --check --diff first: a direct run once restarted Postgres during business hours.
billing-api 3.4.0 was released to production on 2026-10-24 with the new refunds endpoint.

facts.keywords: timezone, UTC, cron, время, часовой пояс
facts.text: All servers (orion, nyx, vega, atlas) run in UTC; cron times in the docs are UTC unless stated otherwise.
